metadata.title: The Missing Heir
metadata.description: Investigate the disappearance of a wealthy businessman's son who vanished under mysterious circumstances
metadata.briefing: You've been assigned to investigate the sudden disappearance of Thomas Blackwood Jr., son of prominent businessman Thomas Blackwood Sr. The young software engineer was last seen leaving his apartment building yesterday afternoon at approximately 2:30 PM. His father reported him missing this morning when Thomas Jr. failed to show up for an important company board meeting - highly unusual behavior for someone described as punctual and responsible. The Blackwood family's prominence in the Portland business community requires this case be handled with both discretion and urgency.

emails.subject: URGENT: Missing Person Case Assignment
emails.content:
Detective Morgan,

You've been assigned to investigate the disappearance of Thomas Blackwood Jr., a 28-year-old software engineer who went missing yesterday afternoon. He was last seen leaving his downtown Portland apartment at 2:30 PM.

His father, Thomas Blackwood Sr., CEO of Blackwood Industries, reported him missing this morning when Thomas Jr. failed to attend a critical board meeting. According to Mr. Blackwood Sr., his son has never missed an important company obligation without notice.

Given the Blackwood family's prominence in our community, this case requires both urgency and discretion. I need you to follow every lead methodically while keeping media attention to a minimum.

Attached you'll find the initial case briefing with preliminary details and a recent photo of Thomas Jr.

Keep me updated on your progress.

Chief Mitchell
Portland Police Department

emails.subject: Digital Forensics Analysis Results - Case #2025-1215
emails.content:
Detective Morgan,

We have completed the digital forensics analysis on the iPhone 14 Pro recovered from Thomas Blackwood Jr.'s apartment.

KEY FINDINGS:

1. Last Activity: Device was last used at 2:15 PM on December 15th, approximately 15 minutes before victim was last seen

2. Call Logs: Three outgoing calls made on the day of disappearance:
   - 10:30 AM to father (Thomas Sr.) - duration 4 minutes
   - 1:45 PM to unknown number (503-555-0142) - duration 12 minutes
   - 2:10 PM to same unknown number - duration 2 minutes

3. Text Messages: Multiple deleted messages recovered from conversation with unknown number. Messages suggest a planned meeting at an undisclosed location.

4. Location Data: GPS history shows victim visited an address in Northeast Portland (1247 Riverside Drive) twice in the week prior to disappearance.

Detailed forensics report has been uploaded to evidence system.

Let me know if you need any additional analysis.

Tech Specialist Rodriguez
Digital Forensics Lab

suspects.name: Thomas Blackwood Sr.
suspects.motive: Recent financial disputes with son over company succession and business ethics disagreements
suspects.alibi: Claims to have been at company board meeting from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM on December 15th
suspects.background: Thomas Blackwood Sr. is a self-made millionaire who built Blackwood Industries from a small manufacturing business into a multi-million dollar corporation over 30 years. Known in business circles for aggressive tactics and unwavering pursuit of profit. Colleagues describe him as demanding and controlling. Recent reports from company insiders suggest increasing tension between father and son regarding the future direction of the company, with Thomas Jr. reportedly opposing several ethically questionable business deals. Mr. Blackwood Sr. has expressed frustration to associates about his son's 'idealistic' approach to business and reluctance to 'do what it takes' to succeed.
